children.value: Answer the following exercises based on the content from this chapter.
Solve the following linear system of equations using the inverse of the coefficient matrix.

children.html: −4x1+2x2=−22,3x1+4x2=11.\begin{align*} - 4 x_{1} + 2 x_{2} &= -22, \\ 3 x_{1} + 4 x_{2} &= 11. \end{align*}−4x1​+2x2​3x1​+4x2​​=−22,=11.​
−4x1+2x2=6,−x1−3x2=−2.\begin{align*} - 4 x_{1} + 2 x_{2} &= 6, \\ - x_{1} - 3 x_{2} &= -2. \end{align*}−4x1​+2x2​−x1​−3x2​​=6,=−2.​
−4x1−4x2−2x3=16,3x1+4x3=−8,x1=0.\begin{align*} - 4 x_{1} - 4 x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &= 16, \\ 3 x_{1} + 4 x_{3} &= -8, \\ x_{1} &= 0. \end{align*}−4x1​−4x2​−2x3​3x1​+4x3​x1​​=16,=−8,=0.​

4x1−4x3=8,4x1−x2+x3=−4,3x1+x2+2x3=−12.\begin{align*} 4 x_{1} - 4 x_{3} &= 8, \\ 4 x_{1} - x_{2} + x_{3} &= -4, \\ 3 x_{1} + x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &= -12. \end{align*}4x1​−4x3​4x1​−x2​+x3​3x1​+x2​+2x3​​=8,=−4,=−12.​

children.value: Solve the following linear system of equations using Cramer’s rule.

children.html: x1+4x2=−20,−4x1+x2=−5.\begin{align*} x_{1} + 4 x_{2} &= -20, \\ - 4 x_{1} + x_{2} &= -5. \end{align*}x1​+4x2​−4x1​+x2​​=−20,=−5.​
x1+x2=4,4x2=12.\begin{align*} x_{1} + x_{2} &= 4, \\ 4 x_{2} &= 12. \end{align*}x1​+x2​4x2​​=4,=12.​

3x1−4x2−4x3=21,−2x1−x2−x3=8,4x1−x2+3x3=−14.\begin{align*} 3 x_{1} - 4 x_{2} - 4 x_{3} &= 21, \\ - 2 x_{1} - x_{2} - x_{3} &= 8, \\ 4 x_{1} - x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &= -14. \end{align*}3x1​−4x2​−4x3​−2x1​−x2​−x3​4x1​−x2​+3x3​​=21,=8,=−14.​

4x1+4x2+x3=5,−2x1+x2+x3=−1,−5x1−4x2+2x3=−14.\begin{align*} 4 x_{1} + 4 x_{2} + x_{3} &= 5, \\ - 2 x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3} &= -1, \\ - 5 x_{1} - 4 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &= -14. \end{align*}4x1​+4x2​+x3​−2x1​+x2​+x3​−5x1​−4x2​+2x3​​=5,=−1,=−14.​

children.value: Solve the following linear system of equations using Gaussian elimination.

children.html: −x1+3x2=−2,−2x1+x2=1.\begin{align*} - x_{1} + 3 x_{2} &= -2, \\ - 2 x_{1} + x_{2} &= 1. \end{align*}−x1​+3x2​−2x1​+x2​​=−2,=1.​

3x1+x2+2x3=11,4x1−4x3=−4,4x1−2x2+x3=13.\begin{align*} 3 x_{1} + x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &= 11, \\ 4 x_{1} - 4 x_{3} &= -4, \\ 4 x_{1} - 2 x_{2} + x_{3} &= 13. \end{align*}3x1​+x2​+2x3​4x1​−4x3​4x1​−2x2​+x3​​=11,=−4,=13.​

−x1−5x2−2x3=−17,2x1−2x2−3x3=−14,3x1−x2+4x3=−13.\begin{align*} - x_{1} - 5 x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &= -17, \\ 2 x_{1} - 2 x_{2} - 3 x_{3} &= -14, \\ 3 x_{1} - x_{2} + 4 x_{3} &= -13. \end{align*}−x1​−5x2​−2x3​2x1​−2x2​−3x3​3x1​−x2​+4x3​​=−17,=−14,=−13.​

−x1−5x2−2x3=−26,2x1−2x2−3x3=−19,3x1−x2−4x3=−20.\begin{align*} - x_{1} - 5 x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &= -26, \\ 2 x_{1} - 2 x_{2} - 3 x_{3} &= -19, \\ 3 x_{1} - x_{2} - 4 x_{3} &= -20. \end{align*}−x1​−5x2​−2x3​2x1​−2x2​−3x3​3x1​−x2​−4x3​​=−26,=−19,=−20.​

3x1−5x2−4x3−x4=28,−4x2+3x3−4x4=41,2x1+3x2+3x3−3x4=11,−2x1+2x2−5x3−4x4=−21.\begin{align*} 3 x_{1} - 5 x_{2} - 4 x_{3} - x_{4} &= 28, \\ - 4 x_{2} + 3 x_{3} - 4 x_{4} &= 41, \\ 2 x_{1} + 3 x_{2} + 3 x_{3} - 3 x_{4} &= 11, \\ - 2 x_{1} + 2 x_{2} - 5 x_{3} - 4 x_{4} &= -21. \end{align*}3x1​−5x2​−4x3​−x4​−4x2​+3x3​−4x4​2x1​+3x2​+3x3​−3x4​−2x1​+2x2​−5x3​−4x4​​=28,=41,=11,=−21.​

2x1−3x2−3x3+4x4=−1,4x1−5x2+x3−5x4=42,3x1+3x2−x3−5x4=20,x1+x3+3x4=−4.\begin{align*} 2 x_{1} - 3 x_{2} - 3 x_{3} + 4 x_{4} &= -1, \\ 4 x_{1} - 5 x_{2} + x_{3} - 5 x_{4} &= 42, \\ 3 x_{1} + 3 x_{2} - x_{3} - 5 x_{4} &= 20, \\ x_{1} + x_{3} + 3 x_{4} &= -4. \end{align*}2x1​−3x2​−3x3​+4x4​4x1​−5x2​+x3​−5x4​3x1​+3x2​−x3​−5x4​x1​+x3​+3x4​​=−1,=42,=20,=−4.​

children.value: For the following linear systems of equations, determine the rank of the coefficient matrix and the augmented matrix and classify the system is consistent, inconsistent or indeterminate and calculate the solution (if possible).

children.html: x1−x2+2x3=2,2x1+x2+4x3=7,4x1+x2+x3=4.\begin{align*} x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &= 2, \\ 2 x_{1} + x_{2} + 4 x_{3} &= 7, \\ 4 x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3} &= 4. \end{align*}x1​−x2​+2x3​2x1​+x2​+4x3​4x1​+x2​+x3​​=2,=7,=4.​

x1−x2+2x3=3,2x1−3x2+7x3=4,−x1+3x2−8x3=1.\begin{align*} x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &= 3, \\ 2 x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 7 x_{3} &= 4, \\ - x_{1} + 3 x_{2} - 8 x_{3} &= 1. \end{align*}x1​−x2​+2x3​2x1​−3x2​+7x3​−x1​+3x2​−8x3​​=3,=4,=1.​

x1+x2−2x3=1,2x1−x2+x3=9,x1+4x2−7x3=2.\begin{align*} x_{1} + x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &= 1, \\ 2 x_{1} - x_{2} + x_{3} &= 9, \\ x_{1} + 4 x_{2} - 7 x_{3} &= 2. \end{align*}x1​+x2​−2x3​2x1​−x2​+x3​x1​+4x2​−7x3​​=1,=9,=2.​
